review.why: Builds a full interview prep pack from the user's real experience: story bank, cited company brief, predicted questions and a debrief.
review.summary: Picks a depth from the time left (triage under three hours up to a multi-day plan), reads what the round scores, chooses a competency framework, mines a story bank with probe layers, writes a dated, cited company brief from public sources, predicts questions per round and drafts opener, why-us, weakness and salary answers. It adds questions to ask, a logistics checklist and a debrief.
strengths: Missing results stay marked as needing a number; ranges are never upgraded to point figures
Declines invented stories and covert live help, with a one-line honest alternative
Every company fact is cited and dated, and old facts are flagged
cautions: Very long, and seven reference files are not read here
Sibling skills for mock interviews, offers and tracking are optional, so the light versions are inside
A section on saving to the vendor's resume app applies only when it is connected
